description: This file defines a PHP class CKEditor that provides methods to embed and configure CKEditor instances in PHP web pages, including creating editors, replacing textareas, handling events, and generating necessary JavaScript code.

classes.name: CKEditor
classes.description: A PHP class for integrating CKEditor WYSIWYG editor into PHP pages, supporting configuration, event handling, and dynamic script generation.

methods.name: editor
methods.description: Creates a CKEditor instance attached to a textarea with specified configuration and events.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a specific textarea element with a CKEditor instance.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces all textarea elements in the document, optionally filtered by class name, with CKEditor instances.

methods.name: addEventHandler
methods.description: Adds an event handler for CKEditor events.

methods.name: clearEventHandlers
methods.description: Clears registered event handlers for CKEditor.

methods.name: addGlobalEventHandler
methods.description: Adds a global event handler for CKEditor events.
